notes.title: Update 1.0.16 is Here!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the release of version 1.0.16 of our game, introducing a highly requested feature to make your gaming experience even more seamless!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107835/e667e3ece222cc0334887aec6455960d4937baaf.png[/img]
[b]What's New:[/b]
Steam Cloud Save: Your game progress can now be saved in the cloud! This feature allows you to continue your adventure from any device seamlessly.

📝 Important Note: To upload your first save file to the cloud, make sure to launch the game on the device where you already have progress. This ensures your data syncs properly to Steam Cloud.

Thank you for your continued feedback and support! We’re committed to making your experience better with each update. If you encounter any issues, please don’t hesitate to let us know.

Happy gaming, and enjoy the convenience of Steam Cloud Save! ☁️🎮

notes.title: Update 1.0.15 is Here!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce the release of version 1.0.15 of our game, introducing a highly anticipated feature to enhance your gameplay flexibility!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107835/f6fd9155b96cf4680add3a2e1ae7ba380db773ba.png[/img]

[b]What's New:[/b]
Hero Upgrade Reset and Refund: You can now reset your hero’s upgrades and receive a full refund of the invested money! This feature is perfect for players who find themselves short on cash for new weapons or skills. Experiment with different strategies without worrying about wasted resources!

Thank you for your continued feedback and support! We’re always working to improve your experience, so stay tuned for more updates. Have fun exploring the Wild West! 🌵

As always, if you encounter any issues or bugs, please let us know. Happy gaming! 🎮

notes.title: Update 1.0.14 is Here!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the release of version 1.0.14 of our game, bringing highly requested features to enhance your gaming experience!

What's New:
[list]
[*] [b]Screen Shake Setting[/b]: You can now enable or disable screen shake in the settings menu, giving you more control over your gameplay comfort.
[*] [b]Custom Keybindings[/b]: Players can now remap keyboard keys to suit their personal preferences. Adjust the controls to fit your playstyle for the ultimate gaming experience!
[*] [b]French Language Added[/b]: We're happy to introduce French as a new language option in the game. Enjoy playing in your preferred language!
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback and support! We’re committed to making the game even better, so stay tuned for more updates. Enjoy the new features! 🎮

Don't forget to report any new issues or bugs. Thank you and see you in the Wild West! 🌵
